harnesses.label: Codex
harnesses.risk_notes: Codex has no per-tool allowlist — access is governed entirely by sandbox_mode (read-only/workspace-write); a tool a definition names but the sandbox mode does not itself restrict is NOT enforced the way claude's per-tool allowlist is.

harnesses.label: Cursor
harnesses.risk_notes: `securityHooks` matches no documented hook contract for this harness; it is keryx's own invention (tracked as OQ-3). Cursor's exact tolerance for extra/unknown .mdc front-matter keys alongside description/alwaysApply is not independently confirmed here — verify on a live install.

harnesses.label: Windsurf

surfaces_unsupported.reason: Windsurf hooks are exit-code only (block/allow); no documented field injects context. Use its rules/memories for standing context.

harnesses.risk_notes: `securityHooks` matches no documented hook contract for this harness; it is keryx's own invention (tracked as OQ-3). Windsurf's exact handling of an unrecognised trigger value or extra front-matter keys is not independently confirmed here — verify on a live install.

harnesses.label: Antigravity

surfaces_unsupported.reason: Antigravity's context-injection hook is unverified (no first-party docs). Its pre-exec block hook IS supported — see `keryx ctx install-hook --runtime antigravity`.

harnesses.risk_notes: No first-party docs confirm this hook contract; verify on a live install.

harnesses.label: OpenCode

surfaces_unsupported.reason: OpenCode's chat.message / experimental.chat.system.transform can inject context in theory, but propagation is undocumented and known-buggy (sst/opencode#17100, oh-my-openagent#885). Left out until stable — use AGENTS.md for standing context.

harnesses.risk_notes: Bridged via a generated plugin file rather than a documented hook config. OpenCode's documented `tools` boolean map is flagged deprecated in favour of `permission`, which this exporter targets — the stability of that migration is not independently confirmed here.

harnesses.label: Zed

surfaces_unsupported.reason: Zed has no scriptable session/prompt hook. Use static agent settings.

harnesses.risk_notes: Zed uses the first matching rules file among .rules, .cursorrules, .windsurfrules, .clinerules, .github/copilot-instructions.md, AGENT.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, ... — an earlier file in that list shadows AGENTS.md even when AGENTS.md itself carries Keryx's block.

harnesses.label: Generic MCP host
harnesses.risk_notes: `securityHooks` matches no documented hook contract for this harness; it is keryx's own invention (tracked as OQ-3).

harnesses.label: Gemini CLI
harnesses.risk_notes: Gemini CLI's hooks default-enabled flag and the version it was introduced in are not confirmed in first-party docs; verify on a live install. Whether Gemini CLI actually reads GEMINI.md end-to-end (beyond the documented context.fileName option) is not independently confirmed here.

harnesses.label: Kiro
harnesses.risk_notes: Kiro's hook stdin field names and its shell tool's name are third-party-reported only, not confirmed by first-party docs. Open Kiro issues report that steering file `inclusion` modes are not always honoured. Kiro's hook stdin field names and its shell tool's name are third-party-reported only, not confirmed by first-party docs — the matcher above is a best guess and may gate nothing on a real install; verify before relying on it. Open Kiro issues report that steering file `inclusion` modes are not always honoured, even with `inclusion: always` set — verify on a live install. Kiro's unknown-key tolerance for .kiro/agents/*.json is not documented, so the managed sentinel is written as the first line of `prompt` rather than a new top-level key; verify on a live install.

harnesses.label: GitHub Copilot agent
harnesses.risk_notes: The shell tool name Copilot's hook payload carries is not documented; the guard parses any tool call carrying `toolArgs.command`. The shell tool's name Copilot's hook payload carries is not documented; this guard parses any tool call whose payload carries `toolArgs.command`, whatever `toolName` is. Whether the Copilot coding agent (as opposed to the Copilot CLI/IDE chat) reads .github/copilot-instructions.md the same way is not independently confirmed here.
